name: groupsummary
expr: [Bs, BGs, BCs] = groupsummary(A, G, 'sum'); Bm = groupsummary(A, G, 'mean'); Bmd = groupsummary(A, G, 'median'); Bx = groupsummary(A, G, 'max'); Bn = groupsummary(A, G, 'min'); Bsd = groupsummary(A, G, 'std'); Bu = groupsummary(A, G, 'numunique'); BM = groupsummary(A2, G, 'sum'); BNn = groupsummary(A, G2, 'sum');
comment: groupsummary array form — methods: sum/mean/median/max/min/std/numunique/nnz/mode/all/any. 3-output [B, BG, BC]. NaN groups form a trailing bucket. Table form, groupbins, function-handle methods, multi-grouping-vars, IncludeMissingGroups/IncludeEmptyGroups NV are deferred (table type not in numkit, binning/handle paths need engine plumbing).
